<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex54022026-02-1912-53-39" status="unreviewed"> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3459">bod</rs><note type="editorial">Gloss only in ID:5990</note></note> bum pa la sogs pa rdzas gcig dang ldog pa tha dad du don la gnas par 'dod do ||
     
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">la la</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang</rs><note type="editorial">Gloss only in ID:5990</note></note> ni ldog pa 'dus nas rdzas rtsom pa yin te khrab dang khrab kyi byang bu bzhin nam chu shing gi lpags pa bzhin no zhes zer ro ||
        
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4020">'ga' zhig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4020">kyal</rs><note type="editorial">Gloss only in ID:5990</note></note> ni log pa dang rdzas ni dngos po yin la ldog pa ni rdzas med yin no zhes sems so ||</seg></TEI>
